entries.en: to revile; to curse and scold
entries.notes: R 栏对音残损（me roy/loy 疑读），释义依 H 罵、M 詈两栏互定，L 词头拼写存疑故降级。

entries.en: to dissuade or obstruct someone face to face
entries.notes: 依 H 面＋M 阻取“面阻”义，R 之 Bin choi 相合；L 之 mala palabra 与中文栏不合，从中、闽两栏。

entries.en: to vent one's anger; to give vent
entries.notes: R 首词有墨渍残迹但 chhu quy 与“出气”相合；L 义为沉思明辨（pensand & discursin claro），与出气不合，从中、闽栏。

entries.en: to revile roundly; to scold freely
entries.notes: H 作“暢罵”，R 首音疑读偏 tong，当为“痛骂”之别写或讹字。

entries.en: to revile severely; to give a good scolding
entries.notes: H 有痛/遍两读，取“痛”（痛骂成词，R 对音亦合）。

entries.en: grain tribute; provisions due as revenue
entries.notes: H 栏空；M“量”之对音近闽南糧字，结合 rentas（王家税赋）义推断为粮税，另存“两（tael）”一读。

entries.zh: 爵位；爵禄（国王所赐封爵及其俸禄）
entries.en: noble rank or title with its royal emoluments; fief revenues granted by the king
entries.notes: H 栏空；R 尾段 djmdaor 疑读无法切分，释义取爵位，合于 L 之王赐租禄（rentas … el Rey）义。

entries.en: government grain tax; official dues paid to the state
entries.notes: “量”可读糧（官粮）亦可读量（官量，官定度量衡），L 之 royal fisco 合粮税义，取官粮为主。
R 栏连读数段难以切分，内含萌/芽读音，取萌芽义；尾部 garboy cixbar 疑读不涉释义。

entries.en: to sprout; to germinate, put forth buds
to hand over the throne; to abdicate in favor of one's heir
as per custom; following the established rule
entries.notes: L 义为赔偿损失（reparar los daños / perdió su hacienda），与随例不合，R 有三重疑读且插文处缺损，四栏语义无法互证，姑取随例。

entries.zh: 补；调补，用药调治将养病人
entries.en: to restore, mend; to tonify (treat the sick with medicine)
to guard against; to beware, take precautions
